items.title: Bob Hardaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: I mean Abe came from that and then he went on the staff, I think he was at Fox I believe. And he was there for many years.

ctx.x: How many Benny Goodman’s Tributes have there been? They can’t say the Benny Goodman Band, but they have to say a “Tribute” to, I’m sure Abe told you that. He just did one in Japan recently. But there were still some bands. The first so-called name band, I played with a few bands, panic sort of bands. The first name band I played with was Ray Anthony. And I think it was ’51, I think. I lost track a little bit, but it was either ’51 or ’52. That’s close enough. And he was very hot at the time. He was about the last…
How did the “Bunny Hop” come around?
